notes.title: Version 2.0 - Now broadcasting!
notes.content:
Get ready for a [b]game-changing update to Chronicles of 2 Heroes[/b]. Since its launch in [b]May 2023[/b], the game has gotten a few minor updates. but now, the team is excited to announce a [b]major update[/b] that's set to elevate your experience to epic new levels. 

[previewyoutube=MiGr3JAJmo8;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]










This new patch brings a series of improvements to graphics, gameplay, and level design! Thanks to your feedback, we have worked hard to enhance the gaming experience to make it even more engaging and enjoyable. Here’s what’s new: 
 
GRAPHICS
[list]
[*] Changed all parallax backgrounds to improve visual depth.
[*] Updated all tilesets for a more detailed and cohesive look.
[*] Added new background and foreground elements for all levels, further enriching the game environment.
[*] New particles added for levels: Izumo Forest, Mount Dogo, Osaka, Kozuki Graveyard, Daisen Sanctuary.
[*] Added new graphic element to visualize the switch power up state.
[/list]
GAMEPLAY 
[list]
[*] Changed switch mechanics: now, when you switch characters, you enter an enhanced form for a limited time: the switch power up state. In this state:
[*] Ayame gains an extra jump (always valid for every switch).
[*] Kensei gains an extra defense point (damage reduction).
[*] Both characters gain 1 extra attack point.
[/list]
LEVEL DESIGN
[list]
[*] Changed all levels to provide a smoother gameplay experience.
[*] Removed and rearranged sections in levels: Izumo Forest, Mount Dogo, Osaka, Kozuki Graveyard, Daisen Sanctuary.
[*] Removed some branching options in Daisen Cave.
[/list]

The update is now available on all platforms! And, of course, this update is free for all.

Join us as we continue to push the boundaries of action platforming with Chronicles of 2 Heroes!

notes.title: Two Heroes, One Epic Challenge: Vote Now!
notes.content:
Heroes, brace yourselves! Do you revel in taking on legendary challenges? Crave that adrenaline rush only a truly hard game can offer? Well, behold the ultimate test - “Chronicles of 2 Heroes”.

Set against the vibrant backdrop of feudal Japan, our game throws you into an enthralling 16-bit action platformer universe fused with Metroidvania magic. As you navigate the perilous world dominated by Amaterasu and her disciple, Empress Himiko, your skills and persistence will be pushed to the brink. It's not just about tackling the ancient challenges; it's about mastering them!

Why is “Chronicles of 2 Heroes” your ultimate challenge?

[list]
[*] Diverse Gameplay: Switch between our protagonists, Kensei and Ayame, in real-time! With Kensei's deadly katana for close combat and Ayame's agility for ranged strikes, strategize to defeat Japan's fiercest.
[*] Old-School Meets Modern: Sure, we're inspired by retro platformers, but we've fine-tuned the experience for the modern warrior. Every jump, every move, every strike is deliberate.
[*] Deep Dive into Mythology: Not just any foes – face ronins, yokai, and other creatures steeped in rich Japanese mythos.
[*] Unlock Abilities: From earth-shattering ground smashes to gravity-defying double jumps, harness up to 20 powerful abilities.
[*] Two heroes. One mission: reclaim the three sacred treasures and put an end to the tyranny of Amaterasu.
[/list]

We’re in the running for the “Best Game You Suck At” in the Steam Awards. This title is a badge of honor, a testament to our commitment to bringing you a game that not only entertains but challenges.

So, do you have what it takes? Vote for us! And if you haven’t yet dived into our world, what are you waiting for? Grab your kunais, sharpen your skills, and face the ultimate test.

Chronicles of 2 Heroes awaits. Will you rise or fall?

notes.title: Version 1.1 - Assist Mode is here!
notes.content:
Hi heroes 👋

Chronicles of 2 Heroes is [b]one month old![/b] We have received loads of support during this time. And some constructive criticism, too. Thankfully, most of our player base values the tough challenge we offer. But there is [b]a significant amount of people who struggle[/b] with some bosses and platforming segments. While we consider the game fair overall, we always wanted as many players as possible to enjoy it.

Consequently, in the spirit of games like Celeste, we have updated Chronicles of 2 Heroes with [b]a brand-new assist mode[/b]. It provides the following benefits:

[list]
[*] [b]Ayame becomes Kirby[/b]. The assist mode allows our kunoichi to jump endlessly while you keep pressing the jump button. She also regains five kunai every 30 seconds.
[*] [b]Kensei got hands[/b]. Our samurai handles attacks better since the assist mode reduces all damage by half heart. Additionally, he deals double damage to ALL enemies, including bosses.
[*] Both heroes recover [b]five hearts every 30 seconds[/b] while the mode is active.
[/list]
[previewyoutube=hX5yO0tPpoI;full][/previewyoutube]
If you think it is broken, do not panic. [b]Assist mode can be toggled on and off anytime[/b] by pressing the designated button. Feel free to activate it when you need extra health, a tad of help with tight jumps or an easier time with bosses. Ultimately, this is meant for you to enjoy our game as you please.

[b]The patch is available now on Steam[/b] and will arrive on other platforms in the following days. We will announce its availability for each console on [url=https://twitter.com/COTH_Game]Twitter[/url] and [url=bit.ly/3NC0xUx]Discord[/url]. Feel free to [b]share your thoughts[/b] on this patch there, too!

See you in the next update.

- Israel, PR & CM.

notes.title: PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
Hello Heroes,

First thing first we want to thank all our supporters and reviewers! 

We would like to express our sincere gratitude for your ongoing support and for taking the time to review our game. Your feedback has been invaluable to us, and we appreciate all the support we have received thus far. For those who haven't yet left a review, we kindly request you to do so, as it holds significant importance for us.

We have carefully listened to your feedback and addressed various issues and bugs that were reported. 

[b]The following fixes have been implemented in this patch:[/b]

[i]- Doors in Osaka level now unlock upon re visiting.
- The critical bug that prevented progress in the final section of Daisen Sanctuary has now been resolved.
- Map upgrades now save correctly and should be visible even in the temple after teleporting.
- "Piercing strike" doesn't unlock after beating Nobumasa.
- Fixed some achievements that weren't unlockable.
- Other minor fixes and adjustments.[/i]



We would also like to take this opportunity to share some exciting news. In the near future, we will be releasing a [b][u]significant update[/u][/b] that introduces a brand [b][u]new accessibility feature[/u][/b]. Stay tuned for more information and updates.

Thank you once again for your continued support. We greatly value your feedback and are committed to providing the best possible gaming experience. Stay connected with us for all the latest news and announcements.

Cheers
IE Team

notes.title: How Japanese mythos inspired us - The Three Sacred Treasures
notes.content:
Hi heroes!

Ayame's and Kensei's main quest during the game is to [b]retrieve the Three Sacred Treasures[/b] to defeat Himiko and Amaterasu.

You might be asking what these treasures are:

⚔️ The Sword - Kusanagi no Tsurugi (草薙劍)
🪞 The Mirror - Yata no Kagami (八咫鏡)
💎 The Jewell - Yasakani no Magatama (八尺瓊勾玉)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41282536/850c70d9c7a0e1c6c8cb3e324531eae4f3688f7a.gif[/img]

Each relic represents [b]one of the three primary virtues[/b]: courage, wisdom, and benevolence. According to legend, Ninigi-no-Mikoto brought them to Earth. He is a legendary ancestor of Japan's imperial line sent by his grandmother Amaterasu to pacify Japan. Ninigi eventually passed down the treasures to Emperor Jimmu, so you could say [b]there is divinity to the ruler of Japan[/b]. In fact, these three treasures are a central element of the enthronement ceremony since 690.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41282536/4737d9bdce10af8882e0f3f7bdf822cf39ee2cd8.jpg[/img]

It makes sense that you will need [b]god-like powers to face divine antagonists[/b] like Amaterasu herself.

We hope you enjoyed this piece of trivia. If you want to know more, stay tuned for future updates!

See you 🔜

- Israel, PR & CM

notes.title: 🗣️🗺️ CONFIRMED LANGUAGES
notes.content:
Hi heroes! 👋

[b]Chronicles of 2 Heroes will release on May 26, 2023[/b]. But you already knew that, didn’t you? We announced it with a fancy new trailer you can watch 📺 [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zH97phSAPJY]here[/url] 📺

However, you probably didn’t know [b]how many languages we'll include in our game[/b]. During our Kickstarter campaign, we confirmed English, Italian, Spanish and a mysterious extra language.
Now we can announce that Chronicles of 2 Heroes will be available in…
 
 🗺️ [b]10 DIFFERENT LANGUAGES[/b] 🗺️

[list]
[*] English
[*] Italian
[*] Spanish
[*] Catalan/Valencian
[*] German
[*] French
[*] Portuguese (Brazil)
[*] Korean
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] Japanese
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41282536/038ce2598ac92ee8645d223a220d40574422cc73.png[/img]

Going from four languages at best to ten is quite a trip. At first, we feared translation being too expensive, but our game is a retro platformer with little dialogue. It was affordable, and we know you all appreciate playing in your native language, so [b]we wanted to invest in our players[/b].

Localization is happening while we write. We strongly believe [b]it will be ready for Day 1[/b]. If that isn’t the case, you will barely need to wait for an update.

Until the release date, don’t forget to wishlist our game here on Steam. Tell us which language you are most hyped about on our [url=https://twitter.com/COTH_Game]Twitter[/url]/[url=https://discord.com/invite/KYGSDfUgSG]Discord[/url].

See you in the next update! 🔜
 
 -Israel, PR & CM.

First things first, we are happy to announce that the kickstarter was a success and we really wanted to thank you for the support!

The team is hard at work to finish the development process, just a little more time and we will be able to release the game! As we are continuing our work on the project we did take some time to polish the demo and the closed beta! see below to have a little summary of the changes.  



DEMO UPDATE
- polished movement and controls
- new ranged AI behavior
- numerous bugfixes

EARLY ACCESS UPDATE
- various changes to levels (smoother experience)
- fixes of various minor bugs on some actors (stalactite, warrior ai, dialogue triggers)
- reworked texts
- added some visual clues when special doors are opened

As always if you find bugs or just want to share a feedback feel free to contact us in our discord server (https://discord.com/invite/KYGSDfUgSG) or on the Steam community page!

Thank you again for the support!
